# MC8T26A - Quad three-state bus transceiver, inverting

Package DIP-16 · family 8T · catalogue file [catalog/chips/MC8T26A.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/MC8T26A.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /RE | enable | low |  | controls pins 2, 5, 11, 14; when not enabled: float; receiver enable input, active low |
| 2 | RO1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by RE; receiver output 1 |
| 3 | BUS1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by DE; bus pin: driver output and receiver input |
| 4 | DI1 | input |  |  | driver input 1 |
| 5 | RO2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by RE; receiver output 2 |
| 6 | BUS2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by DE; bus pin: driver output and receiver input |
| 7 | DI2 | input |  |  | driver input 2 |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 9 | DI3 | input |  |  | driver input 3 |
| 10 | BUS3 | output |  | three-state | enabled by DE; bus pin: driver output and receiver input |
| 11 | RO3 | output |  | three-state | enabled by RE; receiver output 3 |
| 12 | DI4 | input |  |  | driver input 4 |
| 13 | BUS4 | output |  | three-state | enabled by DE; bus pin: driver output and receiver input |
| 14 | RO4 | output |  | three-state | enabled by RE; receiver output 4 |
| 15 | DE | enable | high |  | controls pins 3, 6, 10, 13; when not enabled: float; driver enable input, active high |
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | BUS1 = NOT DI1 | while DE is high BUS1 is the inverse of DI1; otherwise it floats. |
| 2 | RO1 = NOT BUS1 | while /RE is low RO1 is the inverse of BUS1; otherwise it floats. |
| 6 | BUS2 = NOT DI2 | while DE is high BUS2 is the inverse of DI2; otherwise it floats. |
| 5 | RO2 = NOT BUS2 | while /RE is low RO2 is the inverse of BUS2; otherwise it floats. |
| 10 | BUS3 = NOT DI3 | while DE is high BUS3 is the inverse of DI3; otherwise it floats. |
| 11 | RO3 = NOT BUS3 | while /RE is low RO3 is the inverse of BUS3; otherwise it floats. |
| 13 | BUS4 = NOT DI4 | while DE is high BUS4 is the inverse of DI4; otherwise it floats. |
| 14 | RO4 = NOT BUS4 | while /RE is low RO4 is the inverse of BUS4; otherwise it floats. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 48 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -10 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Bus (driver) output: VOL 0.5 V at 48 mA, VOH 2.4 V at -10 mA. Receiver output: VOL 0.5 V at 20 mA, VOH 2.4 V at -2 mA. PNP inputs, -200 uA max low-level input current. ICC 87 mA max (page 4-100). |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BUS | RO | PLH | 14 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, 30 pF load (Figure 1) |
| BUS | RO | PHL | 14 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, 30 pF load (Figure 1) |
| DI | BUS | PLH | 14 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, 300 pF load (Figure 2) |
| DI | BUS | PHL | 14 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, 300 pF load (Figure 2) |
| /RE | RO | PLZ | 15 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C (Figure 3) |
| /RE | RO | PZL | 20 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C (Figure 3) |
| DE | BUS | PLZ | 20 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C (Figure 4) |
| DE | BUS | PZL | 25 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C (Figure 4) |

## Not known

- The data sheet has no function table; the inversion of driver and receiver is read from the bubbles in the pin-connection drawing (page 4-99) and the test waveforms (Figures 1 and 2: the output falls when the input rises).
- No high-level enable/disable times (PZH, PHZ) are given.

## Notes

Identical to the NE8T26A and orderable as MC6880A (page 4-99). The data sheet gives only maximum delays.

## Sources

- [Motorola MC6880A/MC8T26A Quad Three-State Bus Transceiver, in Motorola 1979 Interface Integrated Circuits data book](http://www.bitsavers.org/components/motorola/_dataBooks/1979_Motorola_Interface_Integrated_Circuits.pdf) - 4-99 to 4-103 (PDF pages 160-164); MC8T26A

## Used on sheets

No sheet in this repository uses this chip yet.
